body:
The sourced, versioned profile registry/evaluator and compact current-input
controls are implemented through [PR #180](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/pull/180)
and corrected by [PR #181](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/pull/181). The released
runtime is exact qualified merge `c6f3e283ef3f6bed4a00c6dfe3fef36bf5bc3f82`;
the earlier failed merge remains unqualified.

Seven named toolkit adaptations retain inspectable actual values, operators,
limits, sources and domain conventions. CNS MPO and the scaffold/SOM method remain
explicitly unavailable for documented missing-input/source reasons. Edits,
Undo/Redo, previews, cancellation, original uploads and late results preserve
current-input authority. Deferred drawer focus yields to deliberate and nested
interaction.

Release: [v0.38.0](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/releases/tag/v0.38.0). Immutable annotated tag object:
`7e535c06e19d833d3e4accd63d3963a10dc4a348`. Fresh actual-merged complete qualification:
all 43 commands pass at the exact merged commit: 4,157 Python tests (zero skips), 1,879 frontend, 14 supervisor and 585 browser cases, with exactly 75 unchanged preceding-release exclusions, zero failures/flakes/retries and verified current/preceding source, DATA3, logs and actual readers. Full anonymous verification of the main ZIP,
package/checksum sidecars, both forensic indexes and all 17 forensic ZIP/checksum
pairs: all 37 assets, totaling 2,223,691,882 bytes, pass HTTP 200/full-body EOF/size/SHA256 and applicable recursive CRC, internal manifests and exact disjoint unions; both forensic indexes and all 18 literal checksum bodies reconcile.

All seven specialist agent assessments passed reviewed head
`db6532b20a1b8ac61e7242d349c91c9a99303988`, whose tree matches the actual merge.
These are not human approvals. No dependency/migration is added; schema head 0017,
project/archive 3, viewer 2 and API v1 remain. Actual preceding-reader, scientific
and original/history-preservation evidence is retained.

Portable performance and scientific limitations: 47 profile + 115 inherited-property + one minimization = 163 workflow timing target misses, with four deliberate policy examples separate. These portable observations retain D-148; hard work-order, source, cleanup and resource assertions pass. Hidden retirement remains unavailable.
No strict-host, speedup, universal-capacity, physical-device, simultaneous-memory
or prediction-equivalence claim is made.

#161–#163 remain required, and parent #11 stays open. #153/#164/#165 and the other
recorded parent exclusions remain separate. Normal terminal documentation and
safe owned-branch cleanup follow this verified release reply; they preserve the
immutable runtime tag and all original diagnostic evidence. The program ledger
will record their verified completion before this delivery unit is considered
fully complete.
